_comment: Every offer Business Builder sells, exactly as on the September 2026 price list (~/BB-x-DiPilato/pdf/Price List-BBxDiPilato.pdf). Prices are whole US dollars. `setup` is the one-time build or setup; `monthly` is the care / optimization plan. `paymentLink` and `stripe` are written by scripts/stripe-offers.sh — never type them by hand. To change a price: edit it here, run the script, commit both.

terms: Care is clear scope, not unlimited work. Standard care is monitoring, fault investigation, maintenance and one small change up to 30 minutes a month (Website Starter: 15 minutes). No rollover. Custom-build care is maintenance, not new development.

Honest terms, said out loud. No jobs, revenue, rankings or fixed launch dates are guaranteed. Texting waits for provider approval. Domains, third-party costs and extra integrations are separate. Front-desk packages are not automatically included in custom builds.
Every build starts with a written scope. When you pay online, William calls you to set the scope and your start date. The signed scope sets scope, payment and remedies.
